item.description: Nottinghamshire residents planning weddings, civil partnerships, naming ceremonies or other non-statutory registration services in the coming years will see modest increases in fees after the County Council approved a new structure covering 2027–28 and 2028–29. item.title: Exhibition: Nottingham’s Beautiful Game – Our Footballing Story
item.description: Nottingham Central Library is proud to announce its new exhibition, “Nottingham’s Beautiful Game: Our Footballing Story,” running from 24 November through to May 2026. item.title: Nottinghamshire hospitals introduce mask-wearing after sharp increase in flu cases
item.description: Sherwood Forest Hospitals currently have 51 flu patients, compared to 8 this time last year. The Trust have now introduced mask wearing for staff and the public in all emergency admission areas at King’s Mill Hospital and also in the Urgent Treatment Centre at Newark to try and reduce the spread of flu. item.description: This week marked the final Love Your Streets Day of Action of the year, concluding six months of targeted activity across Nottingham. item.title: Nottinghamshire: Network Rail transports hydrogen by train for first time in the UK
item.description: Network Rail, working with rail and energy partners Freightliner and GeoPura, has transported hydrogen for the first time on Britain’s rail network, marking a major step forward for both the rail and energy sectors. item.title: Police crackdown on Nottingham city crime: 91 arrests, face-coverings banned, 19 city bans, 25 illegal e-bikes seized
item.description: Nineteen people have been banned from Nottingham city centre as part of their bail conditions this Christmas.
